name: bounds and no partial writes
source:
local n = luxio_get_pixel_count()
function loop()
  luxio_fill(11, 22, 33)
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_range, -1, 1, 9))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_range, n, 1, 9))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_range, 0, n + 1, 9))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_range, 0.5, 1, 9))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_range, 0, -1, 9))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill, 256))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill, -1))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill, 1.5))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill, 1/0))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_hsv, 0/0))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_hsv, 0, 1/0))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_hsv, 0, 0, -0.1))
  assert(not pcall(luxio_fill_hsv, 0, 0, 1, 1.1))
  local kind = luxio_get_color_type()
  if kind == "RGBCCT" then assert(not pcall(luxio_fill, 0, 0, 0, 1))
  else assert(not pcall(luxio_fill, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)) end
  luxio_fill_range(n, 0, 255)
  luxio_fill_range(n - 1, 1, 44, 55, 66)
end

name: white channels
HSV clears white channels
source:
function loop()
 local kind = luxio_get_color_type()
 if kind == "RGBCCT" then luxio_fill(0,0,0,0,180,75)
 elseif kind == "RGBW" then luxio_fill(0,0,0,255)
 else luxio_fill(255,190,105) end
 luxio_fill_hsv(1)
end

name: wave mixing, clipping, powers and modulation
sine waves and negative steps
wave white channels
invalid waves leave the entire frame unchanged
source:
function loop()
 luxio_fill(11,22,33)
 local invalid = {
  {{}, {}}, {{{},{},{},{},{}}, {}}, {{{offset=1/0}}, {}},
  {{{positive=1}}, {}}, {{{{phase=0/0}}}, {}}, {{{{step=1e20}}}, {}},
  {{{{amplitude=5}}}, {}}, {{{{},{},{},{},{}}}, {}},
  {{{}}, {{{wave=2}}}}, {{{}}, {{{wave=1,power=1.5}}}},
  {{{}}, {{{wave=1,power=0}}}}, {{{}}, {{{wave=1,power=17}}}},
  {{{}}, {{{wave=1,gain=1/0}}}}, {{{}}, {{offset=0/0}}},
  {{{}}, {{multiply=2}}}, {{{}}, {{multiply=0.5}}},
  {{{}}, {{{wave=1},{wave=1},{wave=1},{wave=1},{wave=1}}}},
  {{{}}, {{},{},{},{},{},{},{}}}, {{{}}, {42}}, {{false}, {}},
 }
 for _, args in ipairs(invalid) do assert(not pcall(luxio_render_waves,args[1],args[2])) end
 local kind = luxio_get_color_type()
 local bad = kind == "RGBCCT" and 4 or 5
 assert(not pcall(luxio_render_waves, {{offset=1}}, {[bad]={{wave=1}}}))
end
